name: The Absent Minded Prospector
summary: This quest marks the final chapter in the search sparked by Prospector Remtravel's excavations in Darkshore. Archaeologist Flagongut in Menethil Harbor seeks to combine Remtravel's finds with his own fossil and the lost Stone of Relu to unlock the ancient titan relics' hidden powers.

sections.title: Cross-Continental Archaeology
sections.body: What began as an escort mission aiding the distracted Prospector Remtravel in the northern reaches of Darkshore leads across the Great Sea to the marshlands of the Wetlands. Flagongut's own original fossil is held by Prospector Whelgar at his excavation site in the Wetlands. Archaeologist Flagongut, reviewing the collected finds, realizes that unlocking the mysterious powers within the fossils requires a key artifact: the Stone of Relu.

sections.title: Lost to the Marshes
sections.body: Before Flagongut could rendezvous with Whelgar, a pack of mottled raptors ambushed his caravan along the road, devouring the Stone of Relu. To piece the mystery together, Flagongut requires an adventurer to hunt down the predatory beasts, recover the ingested stone, and retrieve the original fossil from Whelgar's camp. With both fossils and the key assembled, the dwarven researchers hope to uncover the relics' true origin and power.

faq.q: Why is a Darkshore quest ending in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: The Explorers' League maintains active operations across both Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker sent Remtravel's fossil from Darkshore across the sea to Archaeologist Flagongut in the Wetlands, connecting the two dig sites through shared research.

faq.q: What is the Stone of Relu?
faq.answer: The Stone of Relu is an ancient relic recovered by Archaeologist Flagongut. He believes it acts as a cipher or catalyst capable of unlocking the dormant magical secrets preserved inside the fossils excavated in Darkshore and the Wetlands.

Archaeologist Flagongut is an operative of the dwarven Explorers' League based in Menethil Harbor. He studies ancient relics recovered from surrounding excavations and works closely with Prospectors Remtravel and Whelgar to decipher titan remnants.
Prospector Whelgar holds Flagongut's original fossil at his excavation site in the Wetlands. Remtravel's fossil from Darkshore is the one you already delivered to Flagongut.

faq.q: Why do raptors have the Stone of Relu?
faq.answer: While traveling the Wetlands road to consult with Prospector Whelgar, Flagongut was ambushed by mottled raptors. In the chaos of the attack, one of the predatory beasts swallowed the stone whole.

faq.q: What do the dwarves expect the fossils to do?
faq.answer: The Explorers' League believes ancient fossils from the dawn of Azeroth hold latent titan energies and forgotten history, which can be awakened and translated using specialized relic stones like the Stone of Relu.

angles.text: The quest chain exemplifies the core mission of the Explorers' League, linking remote dig sites across continents to piece together dwarven heritage and the mysteries of the Titans.
Alliance couriers and adventurers frequently bridge the maritime divide between the night elven lands of Darkshore and the dwarven settlements around Menethil Harbor.
